name: @vedmoulya/intelligence-fabric
description: Intelligence Fabric for VedMoulya — a COMPOSITION layer (SPRINT-030) that turns the existing Brain / capability marketplace / provider registry / cost ledger / proactive layer into a provider-neutral orchestration contract: runtime provider-health observation, cost-policy enforcement, autonomy levels, deterministic selection strategies, result normalization, bounded verification chains and workflow bounds. NOT an engine: no Brain / provider-selection / approval / budget / execution / memory / learning / scheduler / notification authority lives here — the frozen estate owns those; this package composes them through narrow ports.
